import numpy as np, itertools
t=np.asarray(df['t'],float);P=np.asarray(df['P'],float);y=np.asarray(df['dP_dt'],float)
B=np.column_stack([1/P,np.log(1+P)**2])
best=[]
V=np.var(y)
for p,q,K,m in itertools.product(np.arange(0.5,2.01,0.1),np.arange(0.5,2.01,0.1),np.arange(4,12.01,0.25),[0.5,1,1.5,2,3]):
    f=t**p*P**q*(1-(P/K)**m)
    A=np.column_stack([B,f])
    cc=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
    e=float(np.mean((A@cc-y)**2)/V)
    best.append((e,round(p,2),round(q,2),K,m,cc.round(4).tolist()))
best.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
for b_ in best[:6]: print(b_)
